metadata.description: Academic research skills for AI agents: find and review the literature in 250 million real papers, develop research ideas, find citations and choose a journal, read papers closely, run systematic reviews and meta-analyses, translate and polish academic English, and analyse, write, check, submit and present a manuscript.

plugins.name: researchzy
plugins.description: Find and use the literature with real papers: search about 250 million records, manage your library and PDFs, write literature reviews that cite only what the search returned, develop research ideas with a logged novelty check, find papers for uncited sentences and keep the quote that supports each, and choose where to submit from evidence. Needs a Researchzy account.

plugins.name: researchzy-reading
plugins.description: Read papers with your agent: lawful full-text downloads, a close reading of one paper, and structured Paper Cards. Works on your own PDFs; no account needed.

plugins.name: researchzy-manuscript
plugins.description: Analyse, write, check, submit and present a paper with your agent: analyse your data, estimate causal effects from quasi-experimental designs, plan and draft from your own results, make and check figures, review the paper as its reviewers will, check references, statistics and availability statements, build LaTeX cleanly, prepare and check the submission package, make slides, write grant proposals, and answer reviewers. No account needed.

plugins.name: researchzy-evidence
plugins.description: Systematic reviews, risk of bias and meta-analysis with your agent: a protocol, logged searches of Researchzy and PubMed, screening with reasons and a PRISMA 2020 flow that adds up, risk-of-bias judgements backed by quotes, and pooled effects with heterogeneity, plots and checked text. Searching the Researchzy index needs the researchzy plugin and a Researchzy account; risk of bias and meta-analysis work on your own files.

plugins.name: researchzy-language
plugins.description: Academic translation and language polishing with your agent: numbers, citations, LaTeX and terms kept exactly, a glossary, side-by-side output, edits limited to language with a reason for each, and scripts that check nothing in the content changed. No account needed.
